final_message:
Fixed! The issue was in the `wrap` function. When a word was longer than the specified width, it would append an empty string to the lines before starting a new line with that word. 

The fix adds a check `if cur:` before appending to lines, ensuring we only add non-empty strings to the output list. This handles edge cases where individual words exceed the width parameter.

All tests pass and the function now correctly handles words longer than the specified width.
